title: A proper average
description:
Read three whole numbers and print their average **with decimals**.

For `1 2 2` the answer is `1.66667`, not `1`.

If you divide an `int` by an `int`, C++ throws the decimals away. Make sure at least one side of the division is a decimal number.
hints: Remember the brackets: `a + b + c / 3` only divides `c`. You want `(a + b + c) / ...`.
Dividing by `3.0` instead of `3` makes the whole calculation use decimals.
